allow: PowerShell(if \($env:JAVA_HOME\) { Write-Output "JAVA_HOME=$env:JAVA_HOME" }; $j = Get-Command java -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($j\) { Write-Output "java: $\($j.Source\)" } else { Write-Output "java not found on PATH" })

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3306 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [PSCustomObject]@{ LocalAddress=$_.LocalAddress; Port=$_.LocalPort; PID=$_.OwningProcess; ProcessName=$p.ProcessName; Path=$p.Path } } | Format-List)

PowerShell(try { Stop-Service -Name 'MySQL80' -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Get-Service -Name 'MySQL80' | Select-Object Name, Status | Format-Table -AutoSize } catch { Write-Output "STOP_FAILED: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(Write-Output '=== DOCKER CONTAINERS ==='; docker compose ps 2>&1; Write-Output ''; Write-Output '=== PORT 3306 OWNER ==='; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3306 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [PSCustomObject]@{ Port=$_.LocalPort; PID=$_.OwningProcess; ProcessName=$p.ProcessName } } | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output '=== MySQL80 SERVICE ==='; Get-Service -Name 'MySQL80' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Status | Format-Table -AutoSize)
